column1: # tests/1300/boots.tsv — the consumer's boots that tests/1300/boots.sh replays on the guards, and what each must record (TVI-WO-1300a (6);
# ruled 2026-11-23 17:16Z). Tab-separated: board; its specification in Aethelgard at the commit below ("-" for ArduPilot, captured by
# `aethelgard simulate --foreign` in 1300 §1.1); the guards it loads (each must witness, recorded, and end); the would-refuse records it must
# make, each "peripheral | rule | kind | bit", separated by " ; ", or "none". Any other record on any boot is a §7 stop, not an edit here.
# The nine per_ck boards are expected to refuse at SPI1 (and SPI2 on two): the scar this work order catches. Aethelgard's AET-WO-4240e
# fixes the generator, and a later change empties their rows.
# d1-drv8876's ADC3EN refusal is 1300's (F8), unmodeled: its ADC3 runs on adc_sclk (ADC3_CCR.CKMODE = 11, p920), which the RCC guard
# cannot see, so the refusal names CKMODE (ruled 17:52Z); an ADC guard that reads CKMODE removes it. Measured 2026-11-23 on 1300's captures (~/.cache/tvi-1300a-from-1300): peaks 504,788-967,372 KiB.
